title: compact-vendor-lockfile-and-selective-distro-packaging-for-airgap-installer
author: Maya K. Patel
description:
Motivation: Reduce offline bundle size for constrained on-prem installs and make distro-specific packaging pluggable. Many customers run in air-gapped environments with strict image quotas (edge appliances, gov clouds). The existing full-vendor bundle duplicates many distro artifacts and pulls in unnecessary CNI/kernel modules; this causes large transfers and slower upgrades. This PR introduces a compact vendor lockfile format + a selective distro packaging pipeline and installer hooks that validate signatures during install/upgrade.
Summary of changes:
- Add a compact OCI lockfile generator that emits minimal index records for required runtime images and optional distro components (kernels, initramfs, cni).
- Implement a packaging pipeline that produces two artifact classes: core-runtime bundle (required) and distro-adapter bundles (optional per distro).
- Add installer-side controller hooks to fetch and validate the compact lockfile, reconcile installed adapters, and apply atomic delta updates (delta snapshots) for adapters only.
- Add package signing verification during preflight and rollback validation to prevent unsigned state after failed upgrades.
- Provide Terraform modules and Helm chart knobs to select which distro adapters are included at bundle creation time.
Checklist:
- [x] generator CLI and YAML/JSON lockfile schema
- [x] packaging pipeline (core + adapters)
- [x] installer controller hooks + preflight checks
- [x] Terraform/Helm knobs and example user flow
- [x] tests: unit tests for lockfile generator, e2e for adapter install path (simulated airgap)
- [x] release notes and upgrade notes
Commits (high-level): 1) add compact lockfile schema and CLI (mgen/lockfile v0.1) 2) packaging pipeline: adapter splitter and manifest builder 3) installer: adapter controller + preflight signature check 4) terraform: module vars + examples 5) helm: chart values and conditional templates 6) tests and CI glue 7) docs and release notes
Changes (files and high-level diffs):
- cmd/mgen/lockfile.go (+420 additions): new CLI to generate compact lockfiles from an OCI index and optional distro manifest.
- build/packager/adapter_splitter.py (+310): splitting logic to create core vs adapter bundles and compute delta snapshots.
- installer/controllers/adapter_controller.go (+560): reconcile loop to apply adapter bundles when present; preflight signature verification hook.
- charts/installer/templates/adapter-hook.yaml (+80): Helm hooks to enable/disable adapter reconciliation.
- terraform/modules/airgap_bundle/variables.tf (+40) and examples/complete-compact.tf (+70): knobs for selecting adapters and signing keys.
- docs/airgap/compact-lockfile.md (+210): guide and migration steps.
- test/e2e/airgap_adapter_install_test.go (+120): simulated offline test using local registry and signed bundles.
Review conversation (selected excerpts):
- Reviewer: "Adapter controller looks good but need stronger idempotency guarantees when a partial delta fails during apply."
- Author: "Agree; added a transactional marker in the controller state to avoid double-apply and added roll-forward logic during reconcile."
- Reviewer: "Can we avoid duplicating kernel modules across adapters?"
- Author: "Adapter splitter now deduplicates by content-hash and writes shared blobs into core-runtime bundle; documented in compact-lockfile.md."
- Reviewer: "Terraform examples need a note about passing KMS signing key ARNs for airgapped environments."
- Author: "Added example and notes; we recommend pre-provisioned KMS keys and offline-signed manifests for fully airgapped sites."
CI status: initial run failed on linter (helm templates flagged), fixed in commit 4, tests: unit tests pass, e2e flaky on CI due to local registry timing -> added retry and increased timeouts; final CI status: pass (all checks green, e2e retried once).
Performance notes: compact bundles reduced total artifact size by ~38% on our baseline (k3s+almalinux+flatcar) in the test harness; installer adapter apply latency for a single adapter ~28s (cold) vs 12s (warm) with shared blobs in core bundle.
Migration notes and user impact:
- Upgrade path: existing full bundles can be converted into compact bundles using the mgen CLI (documented). The installer will accept both formats during a grace period.
- Rollbacks: rollback now validates signatures of the rollback snapshot; unsigned rollback attempts are rejected and leave the cluster in the pre-upgrade state.
- Backwards compatibility: the compact lockfile schema is additive; older installers ignore adapter fields but will still be able to apply core runtime.
Release notes:
- Add compact vendor lockfile and selective distro adapter packaging to reduce airgap bundle size and enable faster adapter-only upgrades.
- New terraform/helm knobs for adapter selection and signing.
- Installer now verifies package signatures preflight and during rollback.
Testing performed: unit tests, integration (packaging pipeline), e2e simulated airgap adapter install, manual validation of signed bundles with KMS-signed manifests.
